# @three-ws/voice

> Speech for avatars — ASR (speech→text), TTS (text→speech), and Audio2Face-3D lipsync visemes in one import. The voice layer for three.ws avatars.

@three-ws/voice is a JavaScript library from three.ws. Install: `npm install @three-ws/voice`.

## Docs

- [README](https://github.com/nirholas/three-ws-voice/blob/main/README.md): install, configuration, full reference
- [Documentation site](https://nirholas.github.io/three-ws-voice/): the README as a web page
- [Full text for LLMs](https://nirholas.github.io/three-ws-voice/llms-full.txt): README inlined
- [AGENTS.md](https://github.com/nirholas/three-ws-voice/blob/main/AGENTS.md): guidance for coding agents
